versions.subject: Merge PR #4399 From @Scoubi - New Rules Related To INDEX_ALLOCATION Potential Abuse
versions.detection:
selection:
    # Note: Both Sysmon and ETW are unable to log the presence of such stram in the CommandLine. But EDRs such as Crowdstrike are able to using for example CMD console history. Users are advised to test this before usage
    CommandLine|contains: '::$index_allocation'
condition: selection
